title: Ellenial · Free tools for everyday life
meta_description: Small tools that make life a little easier. Free and private. No ads, no trackers, no paywalls.
hero_title: Small tools that make life a little easier. Free and private.
hero_lead: Pick the ones you need. Nothing to pay, nothing tracked, nothing sold. What you write is locked on your phone before it goes anywhere, so not even I can read it.
hero_costs: See what it costs to run
lib_lead: One tool to start with. More are growing.

split_desc: Split shared costs with friends, without the awkward maths.
plant_desc: A small reminder that your plants are thirsty.
why_p1: I got tired of downloading apps that promise to be free and to never share or sell my data, but then have micro-transactions for basic features, unreasonably high costs, or can only be used with a subscription. I've literally spent hours unchecking hundreds of trackers and cookies just to use a free app.
why_p2: In the growing world of technology, AI is here to stay, so I started investigating its capabilities myself. The hard lines were the easiest part: no AI-generated art, no paywalls, minimal storing of private data (reducing both costs and risks) and, when needed, always encrypted. Whatever solution I found would have to support this.
why_p3: I started creating an app for myself to understand the limits and was honestly surprised. I realised I could make something out of this and make my life easier. That's where the idea was born to go public, not to make money, but to give back to the community. It's a small niche, but hopefully it can add something to your everyday life.
